title.narrative: Improving food security and climate resilience in Southeast Piauí

description.narrative:
This two year project seeks to improve food security, nutrition and income of 180 families, including a strong focus on female farmers, via climate resilient agroecological farming practices, in 5 rural communities from 3 municipalities in South-east Piaui. The project focuses on the themes of food, climate and gender and is supported by a major donor (covering replacement and special funds).
Key expected changes include: increased access to healthy agroecologically produced food; improved income of farming families through commercialisation of agricultural produce surplus at local markets; improved gender relations amongst men, women and young people from these farming families (including women’s empowerment and participation in decision making spaces in the community); and increased diversification of their agricultural production and regeneration of degraded farmland, contributing to mitigating local climate impacts in the semi-arid region of South-east Piaui.
These will be achieved via: 8 training workshops on agroecological and climate resilient farming practices, and 8 workshops on gender relations; setting up a community solidarity fund in the five communities to serve as an investment fund for current and future family and community-based agricultural initiatives; technical agronomist support to 180 families from 5 farming community groups to plant agroecological kitchen gardens, 18,000 fruit seedlings, and install 5 native seed banks in communities; technical support on commercialisation of produce at local markets including equipment and value chain inputs.
